Jordan: Morning team — quick async standup. Drop 1) yesterday 2) blockers 3) today. Focus: pipeline + any enterprise security asks (HSM/KMS/on‑prem). I’ll compile for EOD.

Mira: NimbleHealth pilot — demo went well. Customer wants BYOK/HSM details and an on‑prem option. Sales request: HSM integration doc. Blocker: need ETA from eng‑security on certs. @eng-security any update? :eyes:

Sam: Kestrel deal — legal is reviewing DPA, no sec tech blockers yet. Blocker: PROD network egress rules for private deploy (infra ticket #4521). Today: chase infra + send network checklist to customer.

Alex: Sent PR for onboarding terraform module, needs one more review from eng‑infra. Ping @jordan and @mira for acceptance criteria. Quick test command: `terraform apply -var='env=staging'` — pls note config path in README. :computer:

Carmen: NovaGrid asking for guaranteed P95 latency in SLA for Dedicated. Blocker: need product + eng to confirm exact SLA wording. @jordan can you loop in Product? :thinking_face:

Jordan: Noted. I’ll loop Product. Eng‑security said yesterday they can deliver a BYOK integration doc by EOD tomorrow; if a customer needs HSM sooner we can propose initial KMS flow with caveats. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Reminder: Dedicated capacity onboarding checklist updated — https://redwood.internal/playbooks/dedicated-onboard (view access required).

Mira: Added customer contacts and notes to shared drive, will follow up with them at 4pm PT. :calendar:

Sam: Follow up on infra ticket #4521 — assigned to @ravi. Ravi, any blockers on your side? :ping_pong:

Ravi: On it. Need a sample firewall policy / CIDR ranges from the customer. If they can’t provide, we can propose egress NAT + proxy. ETA: EOD today. :ok_hand:

Jordan: Great. Alex — please rebase the PR and add a short note about config location so sales can share it with customers. Otherwise thumbs up. :thumbsup:

Carmen: I’ll draft the SLA language with Product and post for review tomorrow AM. Thanks all. :pray:
